description:
Ever.Ag is on a mission to empower agricultural supply chains to feed a growing world. As a Digital Marketing Web Specialist, you will own the design, build, and continuous improvement of the company's core digital properties, crafting experiences that convert and ensuring a strong online presence.

Design and build web pages and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — with clean, maintainable code you're proud of

Develop and maintain page templates, layouts, and components within WordPress using the Divi builder

Translate Figma mockups and wireframes into responsive, pixel-perfect web pages across devices and browsers

Author and publish content across the site, ensuring brand alignment, accuracy, and a consistent voice

Uphold and evolve our design system: typography, color, spacing, and reusable components

Ensure accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and mobile responsiveness on every page

Build and manage landing pages, forms, CTAs, and email templates in HubSpot

Maintain HubSpot CMS modules and theme elements that power our marketing campaigns

Support the integration between HubSpot and WordPress for seamless lead-gen workflows

Oversee day-to-day platform operations: updates, content edits, and site maintenance

Implement on-page SEO best practices: metadata, heading hierarchy, structured data, and image optimization

Apply Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies so Ever.Ag content surfaces accurately in AI-driven search (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and beyond)

Structure content with clear, authoritative, citation-friendly formatting to maximize visibility in AI-generated responses

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and technical health using standard analytics and web tools

Conduct QA across pages and campaigns to ensure accuracy and a polished experience every time

Create wireframes, page layouts, and design prototypes in Figma

Improve navigation, CTAs, and conversion pathways based on user behavior and data

Collaborate with content and marketing to produce visually compelling, on-brand digital experiences

Support creative production of graphics, banners, and web visual assets

Partner with demand gen, content, social, and design teams on web-driven campaigns

Coordinate with vendors and developers on infrastructure or complex feature work

Support integration of websites from acquired companies into the Ever.Ag digital ecosystem

As a Digital Marketing Web Specialist, you will own the design, build, and continuous improvement of the company's core digital properties, crafting experiences that convert and ensuring a strong online presence.

mustHave: Bachelor's degree in web design, digital media, marketing, communications, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience
2–4+ years of experience in web design, front-end development, or web authoring
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for building and editing web pages
Experience designing and prototyping in Figma
Hands-on experience with WordPress and the Divi page builder — creating and editing pages, templates, and modules
Working knowledge of HubSpot CMS: landing pages, forms, CTAs, and email templates
Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and GEO strategies for AI-driven search visibility
Sharp eye for layout, typography, and visual consistency — you notice when something's 2px off
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced marketing environment
preferredHave: Backend experience (PHP, Python, or similar) is a plus
